auth.installation.hero_title: Initialize a fresh Trinacria CMS instance
auth.installation.hero_body: Create the first operator, activate the initial session, and hand control to the admin kernel. This flow is meant for the first boot of a clean installation.
auth.installation.form_summary: Define the first operator account that will own the initial session and unlock the backoffice runtime for the current instance.
auth.installation.highlight.single_windo: The installation endpoint is designed to run once, before the platform starts serving normal operator sessions.
auth.installation.highlight.seed.title: First operator seed
auth.installation.highlight.seed.text: The account created here becomes the first trusted operator of the CMS and unlocks the admin shell.
auth.installation.highlight.handoff.text: After bootstrap, the flow signs in automatically so the backoffice can continue without a second manual step.
auth.installation.highlight.kernel.title: Kernel-driven admin
auth.installation.highlight.kernel.text: Once installed, the backoffice surface is mounted by the admin kernel and follows the same plugin-driven runtime model.
auth.installation.footer: After the first successful bootstrap, this screen is replaced by the normal operator login flow.
auth.installation.info: This action initializes the operator surface for the current CMS instance.
auth.installation.error.already_complete: This CMS instance has already been initialized.

auth.installation.error.generic: Unable to complete the installation. Try again.

settings.title: Settings definitions
settings.summary: This view is read-first and owner-aware. Operators can inspect definitions, resolved values, and masked secret metadata, then prepare non-secret write handoffs for the owner plugin without bypassing signed ownership rules.
settings.overview.title: General site details
settings.overview.summary: This surfaces the most useful metadata detected from registered settings, closer to what operators expect from a classic CMS settings area.
settings.overview.active_definitions_hin: Definitions currently enabled in the visible catalog.
settings.overview.owner_plugins_hint: Plugins currently contributing settings to this catalog.
settings.overview.not_configured_hint: No compatible key was found in the current catalog.
settings.policy.title: Why settings stay guarded
settings.policy.ownership.title: Plugin ownership is preserved
settings.policy.ownership.body: Settings writes and secret reveals are protected by the plugin-caller signature protocol, so the backoffice does not bypass ownership rules through a generic admin JWT.
settings.policy.json_first.title: JSON-first inspection
settings.policy.json_first.body: Operators can still inspect definitions and resolved values, which is usually what matters for debugging configuration drift.
settings.inspect.title: Inspect setting
settings.inspect.description: Raw configuration views help operators understand effective values, defaults, and schema hints without bypassing plugin ownership constraints.
settings.inspect.no_resolved_value: No resolved value is currently available for this definition.
settings.inspect.no_secret_metadata: No masked secret metadata is currently available for this key.
settings.inspect.value_unavailable: The backoffice could not load the resolved value for this setting.
settings.inspect.secret_unavailable: The backoffice could not load masked secret metadata for this setting.
settings.write_flow.title: Owner-signed write handoff
settings.write_flow.summary: The backoffice does not write settings directly. Prepare the next non-secret value here, then hand the payload to the owner plugin so it can sign and execute the request.
settings.write_flow.draft_hint: Edit the non-secret JSON value to hand off. The request is only prepared, never executed from the admin session.
settings.write_flow.invalid_json: The draft value must be valid JSON before the handoff can be prepared.

api_keys.secret.title: Latest issued credential
api_keys.secret.summary: Raw API keys are only visible on create or rotate. Store them in a vault before leaving this view.
